requirements.description: The system may learn over durable configurations such as profiles, strategies, threshold values, and style versions using a binary per-round signal of whether anything was committed, never a per-candidate preference, and constrained to configurations whose measured set diversity clears a floor
requirements.title: Configuration bandit

requirements.description: The system may score candidates from measured external outcomes once publish or conversion telemetry exists, joined through a reserved outcome reference on the selection event

requirements.description: The system may add embedding-based semantic diversity alongside the lexical tier once an embedding surface is available through ai-gateway

validation.notes: Embedding-backed semantic set measurement is resolved through ai-gateway in generateResolved and recorded on the round; document-level semantic repetition is measured at assembly.
